questions.text: A train covers a distance of 270 km in 4.5 hours. What is the speed of the train?

The price of fuel decreases by 50%, 40% and 20% in three successive months, but increases by 50% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price?
Raju has ₹50 more than Riya. Together they have ₹350. How much money does Raju have?
In a test, B got 50 marks while A got 75 marks, out of 85 maximum marks. What percentage of A's marks was B's marks? (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)

Two pipes, A and B, can fill a cistern in 6 hours and 8 hours, respectively. Pipe C can empty the cistern in 10 hours. Initially, pipes A and B are opened together to fill the cistern for 3 hours. After 3 hours, pipe A is closed, and pipes B and C are opened together. By what percentage was the time taken by pipes B and C to fill the remaining part of the cistern greater than the time taken by pipes A and B to fill it in the first 3 hours? Ans A. B. C. D.
In a quadrilateral QRST, ∠ Q = 96° and ∠ R = 43°. The bisectors of ∠ S and ∠ T meet at E. What is the measure of ∠ TES?
An agent sells a turbo cooker with a marked price of ₹6,370 at a discount of 60%. What is the selling price (in ₹) of the turbo cooker?
If an item is bought for ₹800 and sold for ₹740, what is the loss percentage?
Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,000 at 7% per annum rate of interest for the period from 11 February 2023 to 25 April 2023.
The mean and the mode of a set of data are 86.7 and 51.3, respectively. Find the median of the data, using the empirical formula.
If the fourth proportional to P, 15 and 20 is 1, then find the value of P.
The difference between the ages of Girish and Rohan is 10 years. 15 years ago, Girish was twice as old as Rohan. Find Girish's present age.

A sphere is lowered into water which is filled up to the brim in a conical vessel of radius 12 cm and height 16 cm. The size of the sphere is such that when it touches the sides of the cone, the sphere is just immersed into the cone. Find the ratio of the volume of water that has overflown to the volume of water left in the cone.

₹10,511 is divided among X, Y, and Z in such a way that if ₹87, ₹42, and ₹12 be deducted from their respective shares, they have money in the ratio 6 : 16 : 12. Find the difference between the Y’s and Z’s original shares.
The arithmetic mean of the observations 52, 40, 76, 99, 52, 27, 80, 27 and 24 is:
Find a single discount (approximately) equal to three consecutive discounts of 11%, 12% and 2%.
102 men have provisions for 30 weeks. They are joined by 78 men. How long (in weeks) will the provisions last?
